findings.problem: The slide carries the observe.video resource (Khan Academy, Prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells) before the card sort. The deck's own glance and do_not_show say it can give away the sort answers and should only be shown after the sort. The slide notes only say 'optional, show if time allows' and never say to hold it until after the sort. A teacher could play it before Part C and spoil the sort.
findings.fix: Remove the resource from this slide and attach it to 'What the card sort showed' (Explain), or keep it off the student slides. If it stays, add a notes line: 'Do not play before the card sort.' Make the glance, slide and do_not_show agree.

findings.slide: Draw Version 1 of your cell model
findings.problem: The SoW gives 12 minutes for the whole model task: sketch, 8 labels, a Key sentence per label, and a 2-minute partner share. The deck gives the sketch and Key 6 minutes, so about 4 of the SoW's 10 minutes (a 40% cut). The say line changes to 'You have 6 minutes', which is unrealistic for 8 labels plus 8 sentences. Meanwhile the deck adds steps that are not in the SoW: marking predictions, the Yes/No vote, and a next-lesson prediction. The build_log's claim that no trim is more than about a quarter is not true for this core task.
findings.fix: Give the sketch and Key about 9 to 10 minutes. Pay for it by dropping or shrinking the added steps (Back to our predictions, the vote, the next-lesson prediction) and by cutting the 'Model: Version 1' intro slide to 1 minute. Restore the SoW say line ('You have 12 minutes' for the whole task) or state clearly that the time is shared.

findings.slide: Sort: prokaryote or eukaryote? / The ugali kitchen / Map the kitchen to the cell
findings.problem: The SoW says 'You have 8 minutes' to sort, then cold-call disputed cards and photograph the table (10 minutes in all). The deck sets a 6:00 sort timer, leaving about 2 minutes for justifying disputed cards and photographing. Part A (the kitchen analogy) loses 4 of 15 minutes (27%), more than a quarter, while added steps use time elsewhere.
findings.fix: Keep the 8-minute sort timer, or make the timer match the notes. Take a minute from the added steps and give it to Part A or the card sort so no part loses more than a quarter.

findings.problem: The answer key follows the SoW and marks the cell wall RED (plant eukaryotes only), but the deck's own bacterium diagram shows a cell wall. The build_log flags this, but the slide's science_note is empty. A teacher who sees a learner's question has no scientific guidance. The if_then only says to write a yellow note and does not tell the teacher the true answer.
findings.fix: Add a science_note on this slide: 'Bacteria also have cell walls (made of different material). The SoW colour key is a simplification. For the SoW owner.' Keep the build_log flag.

findings.problem: The slide says to sort into two columns, but 'Has ribosomes' and 'Has a cell membrane' are true of both cell types. This is flagged in the build_log, but nothing on the slide or in the notes tells the teacher how to handle these two cards while groups sort.
findings.fix: Add a do or if_then line: 'Some groups will put these cards in the middle or between columns. Allow it and use it in Explain.' Keep the flag for the SoW owner about the two-column design.

findings.slide: Draw Version 1 of your cell model
findings.problem: The student slide says 'Use a pen, because you will add a new colour later', and the model notes say learners revise 'in a new colour each lesson'. The SoW says the page will be 'physically revised (not replaced)' and gives no colour rule.
findings.fix: Remove the colour instruction from the student subtitle and notes, or log it as an added step. Keep it as 'This page will be revised, not replaced.'

findings.problem: The slide shows only the colour key. The learners have no diagram on screen to colour, so they depend on A3 sheets or ARES cards, which the resource list does not supply. The notes just say to 'look back at the diagram slides'.
findings.fix: Show the small diagrams (animal, plant, bacterium) on this slide, or tell the teacher to leave all three diagram slides available. Add printed sheets to the materials.

findings.problem: The SoW key says the cell wall is RED (plant eukaryotes only), but the deck's own bacterium diagram labels a cell wall. A learner who colours it GREEN from that diagram is correct, yet the notes tell the teacher to 'address any other answer'. The build_log flags this, but the slide's science_note is empty, so the teacher is not warned at the point of use.
findings.fix: Keep the SoW key. Add a science_note on this slide: bacteria also have a cell wall (different composition) and some animal cells have small vacuoles, so RED means 'the SoW's plant-cell key'. Tell the teacher to accept and discuss a learner's reasoned GREEN for the bacterium's cell wall, and report this to the SoW owner.

findings.slide: Sort: prokaryote or eukaryote? / Explain how Amina's body made new skin cells
findings.problem: The SoW says 'You have 8 minutes' for the sort and 'Allow 8 minutes' for CER writing. The deck sets 6:00 timers for both and drops the '8 minutes' wording from the say line. The trims are logged, but each timer is cut by 25% and the cold-calling of disputed cards has little time left.
findings.fix: Give back 1 to 2 minutes to the sort and CER timers. Take them from slides with spare time, or from the Model Building phase, which grew from 12 to 13 minutes. If the 6:00 timers stay, make the say line match the actual time.

findings.problem: One minute is allotted to cold-calling 3 pairs with a 5-second wait each, writing key words on the board and taking a hands-up count. This is unrealistic for a large class. The Pair share slide has a spare 30 seconds. The notes also say to choose pairs deliberately, where the SoW simply says to cold-call 3 pairs. The hands-up 'every cell has a nucleus' count is not in the SoW and is not logged.
findings.fix: Move the spare 30 to 60 seconds from the Pair share slide to this slide (Pair share 1.5, this slide 2). Log the hands-up count as an addition or remove it.

findings.problem: The SoW gives a 2-minute partner share after the Limitation Statement. The time_note says '2-minute partner share', but the timer is 1:00 and the slide is 3 minutes in all. This also includes the added next-lesson prediction.
findings.fix: Set the partner-share timer to match the SoW (about 2:00), or drop the next-lesson prediction sentence to free the time. Make the time_note and the timer agree.

findings.problem: The student table asks for Country and period, but nothing in the deck or the SoW supplies a reading. The only resource attached, model.reading, is a practice exercise. The lesson depends on a teacher-made reading, and the dates in the answer key are added facts that appear only in the notes.
findings.fix: Add a short teacher-reference text in the notes giving the three scientists, countries and periods, marked as added_fact. Alternatively, tell the teacher to check that ARES model.reading contains them. Keep the 'verify' flag.

findings.slide: Sort: prokaryote or eukaryote? / Lesson at a glance
findings.problem: The SoW safety note covers scissors for cut-and-paste work and a filtered internet if learners research online. The deck builds the card sets by copying them onto paper strips (which implies cutting) and sends learners to ARES cards. It carries no reminder about careful cutting or filtered internet.
findings.fix: Add one line to the card-sort or before-class notes: handle scissors carefully (link to Amina's cut finger), and make sure any internet use for research is filtered.

findings.problem: For the SoW owner: the SoW has the teacher label the kitchen on the board (door = cell membrane, recipe book = nucleus/DNA, jiko = mitochondria) before asking 'which part is like the cell membrane?' and before learners complete the mapping table. This gives away the answers to both tasks. The deck follows the SoW.
findings.fix: The deck keeps the SoW. Add a note to the teacher: draw the outline and name each item, but write the cell-part labels only after learners answer or complete the table. Report to the SoW owner.

findings.problem: The SoW has the teacher point to the prokaryote diagram, but this slide shows no diagram. The notes send the teacher back through earlier slides. The notes also allow an ARES video on a 3-minute slide, which cannot fit with the 9-minute instruction block.
findings.fix: Add a small bacterium diagram (template bacterium) to this slide, or have the teacher keep the diagram slide open. Say that the video is only an optional follow-up or homework, not part of the 3-minute slide.

build_log.sow_says: Predict about 6.5 min (3 writing + 90 s pair share + sharing); Observe 45 min (Part A 15, Part B 20, Part C 10); Explain about 22 min (12 direct instruction + 8 CER + cold-call/thumbs); Driving Question Board about 6 min (4 reflection + reading notes); Model Building 12 min. Total about 89 min.
build_log.deck_does: Predict 6, Observe 35 (A 12, B 15, C 8), Explain 17 (instruction 9, CER 6, sharing 1, predictions 1), Driving Question Board 5, Model Building 13 (1 intro, 9 sketch and Key, 3 limits). With unit map 1, goals 1 and summary 2 the lesson is exactly 80 minutes. No part loses more than about a quarter. Model Building is not trimmed.
build_log.why: The SoW times add up to more than 80 minutes.

build_log.sow_says: Sort cards: 'You have 8 minutes.' CER: 'Allow 8 minutes of silent writing.'
build_log.deck_does: The card sort slide is 8 minutes with a 6:00 timer, leaving time for cold-calling disputed cards. The CER slide is 6 minutes with a 6:00 timer.
build_log.why: Needed to fit 80 minutes. The timers are shorter than the SoW's stated times.

build_log.slide: Back to our predictions; Does our evidence answer it yet?; The limits of my model
build_log.sow_says: No step where learners mark their earlier predictions, no class vote at the Driving Question Board, and no next-lesson prediction.
build_log.deck_does: Adds a 1-minute predictions-marking slide in Explain, a quick hands-up vote on the Driving Question Board slide, and a next-lesson prediction sentence at the end of Model Building.
build_log.why: The manual (Sections 6 and 8) requires these steps. They are kept as short as possible.

build_log.sow_says: A set of 12 feature cards (e.g., 'Has a nucleus', 'DNA floats freely', 'Has mitochondria', 'Found in bacteria'). The teacher moves also name 'Has ribosomes' and 'Has no membrane-bound nucleus'.
build_log.deck_does: Adds card: 'DNA is inside a nucleus'. Answer: Eukaryote.
build_log.why: To complete the set to 12 (6 are named in the SoW). Follows from the lesson's statement that eukaryotes have a membrane-bound nucleus. Teacher to check.

build_log.sow_says: A set of 12 feature cards (e.g., ...)
build_log.deck_does: Adds card: 'Has an endoplasmic reticulum'. Answer: Eukaryote.
build_log.why: To complete the set to 12. The endoplasmic reticulum is shown in the eukaryote diagrams and not in the bacterium diagram. Teacher to check.

build_log.sow_says: A set of 12 feature cards (e.g., ...)
build_log.deck_does: Adds card: 'Found in animal cells'. Answer: Eukaryote.
build_log.why: To complete the set to 12. The animal cell is a eukaryote in the lesson diagrams. Teacher to check.

build_log.sow_says: A set of 12 feature cards (e.g., ...)
build_log.deck_does: Adds card: 'Found in plant cells'. Answer: Eukaryote.
build_log.why: To complete the set to 12. The plant cell is a eukaryote in the lesson diagrams. Teacher to check.

build_log.sow_says: A set of 12 feature cards (e.g., ...)
build_log.deck_does: Adds card: 'Has no membrane-bound organelles'. Answer: Prokaryote.
build_log.why: To complete the set to 12. The SoW says prokaryotes lack membrane-bound organelles (summary prompt). Teacher to check.

build_log.sow_says: A set of 12 feature cards (e.g., ...)
build_log.deck_does: Adds card: 'Has membrane-bound organelles'. Answer: Eukaryote.
build_log.why: To complete the set to 12. The SoW says eukaryotes have membrane-bound organelles (summary prompt). Teacher to check.

build_log.sow_says: 'They physically sort cards into two columns on their desk: PROKARYOTE / EUKARYOTE.' The teacher moves say ribosomes are 'present in BOTH'.
build_log.deck_does: Keeps two columns. Notes tell the teacher that 'Has ribosomes' is true for both and learners may place it between the columns. The answer key lists it as Both.
build_log.why: A two-column sort has no place for a card that is true for both. Teacher to check.

build_log.sow_says: Evidence Table column: 'Country/Period'. The SoW gives no countries or dates.
build_log.deck_does: Answer key: Schleiden, Germany, 1838; Schwann, Germany, 1839; Virchow, Germany, 1855.
build_log.why: Established textbook facts needed for the answer key. Teacher to verify. Used only in the notes.

build_log.sow_says: 'They read the embedded text on cell theory' on ARES resource cards (or printed A3 diagram sheets).
build_log.deck_does: Says learners read ARES cards or printed sheets. Cites model.reading (The Cell Theory Practice) only as a resource. No reading text is written.
build_log.why: The SoW does not give the text or list the A3 sheets or cards as resources. The teacher must supply a reading with the countries and periods.

build_log.sow_says: Groups receive a set of 12 feature cards; sticky notes in two colours; 'Version 1 checklist'.
build_log.deck_does: Gives no quantities for cards per group, sticky notes or A3 sheets.
build_log.why: The SoW gives no quantities. The teacher decides before class.

build_log.sow_says: 'GREEN = present in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes, BLUE = eukaryotes only, RED = plant eukaryotes only' and 'cell wall is RED'.
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the SoW colour key. Answer key: RED = cell wall, vacuole.
build_log.why: Bacteria also have a cell wall (shown on the bacterium diagram in this deck), so a cell wall is not 'plant eukaryotes only'. Some animal cells also have small vacuoles. Please check.

build_log.slide: Map the kitchen to the cell
build_log.sow_says: Learner experience: ''The kitchen itself / the jiko boundary' → 'Cell membrane''. Teacher moves: 'door = cell membrane', 'jiko (stove) = mitochondria'.
build_log.deck_does: Uses one mapping: door = cell membrane, jiko = mitochondria, recipe book = nucleus/DNA, sufuria, mwiko and chopping board = organelles.
build_log.why: The SoW gives two different mappings for the cell membrane and the jiko.

build_log.sow_says: Unit phenomenon: 'A Form 1 student in Nairobi cuts their finger'.
build_log.deck_does: Does not use 'Form 1' on any slide. Refers to Amina.
build_log.why: Under CBE the term is Grade 10 or learner, not Form 1. The SoW text has not been changed.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson header: 'Sub-Strand 1.1: Cell Structure'. Unit text: 'Sub-Strand 1.3: Cell Structure and Specialisation'.
build_log.deck_does: Does not show the sub-strand number on the phase slides.
build_log.why: The sub-strand number does not match within the SoW.

build_log.slide: Predict: What do all cells share?
build_log.sow_says: 'display the phenomenon image (Amina's healing finger, cross-section diagram from Lesson 1)'. Lesson 1 overview uses a narrated photo sequence or the teacher's description and does not name Amina.
build_log.deck_does: Shows a drawing of Amina with a plaster on her finger. Notes tell the teacher to display the Lesson 1 image.
build_log.why: No cross-section diagram is listed in Lesson 1, and Lesson 1 does not name Amina. The SoW owner should check.

build_log.slide: Draw Version 1 of your cell model
build_log.sow_says: Skills: 'sketch and label a generalised plant and animal cell diagram'. Model Building: 'a generalised eukaryotic cell (they may choose plant or animal)'.
build_log.deck_does: Follows the Model Building phase: learners choose plant or animal.
build_log.why: The skills statement and the model task do not match.

build_log.slide: Explain: What the card sort showed
build_log.sow_says: ARES resource cards in Observe; no video named.
build_log.deck_does: Moves observe.video (Khan Academy, Prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells) from the prokaryotic cell slide to the Explain slide 'What the card sort showed'. Notes say: do not play before the card sort.
build_log.why: The video could give away the card sort answers. Part B should list it with a do_not_show warning until after the sort.

build_log.sow_says: 'Groups receive a set of 12 feature cards'; 'Hand out sticky notes (two colours...)'; 'star sticker'; 'ARES platform resource cards (or printed A3 diagram sheets)'.
build_log.deck_does: Glance materials list these items without quantities per group or per learner.
build_log.why: The SoW gives no quantities (cards per group, sticky notes, star stickers, A3 sheets, pens). The teacher decides before class.

build_log.sow_says: 'No hazardous materials are used in this lesson. If learners use scissors or sharp tools for any cut-and-paste diagram activity, remind them to handle these carefully.'
build_log.deck_does: Sets is_practical to false and builds no Safety slide. The SoW's activities have no cutting task.
build_log.why: The lesson has no practical or demonstration. If the teacher adds cutting, a safety reminder is needed.

build_log.sow_says: Observe: 'Learners are directed to their ARES platform resource cards (or printed A3 diagram sheets)'. No resource is named.
build_log.deck_does: Marks predict.video (also observe.video), explain.reading, dqb.reading and model.reading as preview_first. Marks predict.reading, observe.reading, explain.video, dqb.video and model.video as do_not_use. Puts observe.video and explain.reading only on 'What the card sort showed' and model.reading on the cell theory slide.
build_log.why: Several resources would spoil the card sort or belong to Lessons 3, 4 and 5. None is an exact match for the SoW's own ARES cards.

build_log.sow_says: No video or reading is named for this lesson.
build_log.deck_does: Adds a do_not_show warning that observe.video must not play before the card sort, and keeps it off the prokaryotic cell slide.
build_log.why: The video could give away the sort answers. Part B (the SoW owner) should list it with a do_not_show warning.

build_log.sow_says: Keywords: 'cell theory, prokaryotic cell, eukaryotic cell... nucleus, ...'
build_log.deck_does: Key words shown before Predict are cell, cell theory, analogy and model only. Prokaryotic and eukaryotic appear only in goals.
build_log.why: Defining prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells before the Predict and card sort tasks would give away the sort. Structure words are introduced on later slides.
